PM Modi addresses rally in Punjab, criticizes state government

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed a rally in Punjab, marking the start of election campaigning. During his address, he criticized the current state government led by Bhagwant Mann. The event signals the commencement of political activities for upcoming elections in the region.
